selection.ownership: Retently is a remote-first CX/NPS SaaS with public offices at 72 Mihai Eminescu st, of 206, Chisinau, Moldova and 1606 Headway Cir STE 9078, Austin, TX 78754, United States. The reviewed edition is the English REST API at https://app.retently.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official Retently CX API v2 (host https://app.retently.com, recommended X-Api-Key, GET /api/v2/ping, customers, feedback, templates), authentication help article, security page, about-us geography, and dated incident search. Distinguished Rently proptech (use.rently.com). No qualifying current unresolved Retently customer-data compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Retently CX API v2 documents HTTPS host https://app.retently.com, recommended X-Api-Key header (legacy Authorization api_key= and query api_key still work), GET /api/v2/ping as the lightweight account health/status check, GET /api/v2/customers, GET /api/v2/customers/{customerId}, GET /api/v2/feedback, GET /api/v2/templates, 401/404 isolation, and 150 req/min. Operator is a remote-first Moldova/US company shipping an international English API. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying current unresolved Retently compromise after distinguishing Rently proptech.

incidents.finding: Bounded search of Retently / retently.com security breach and incident coverage on 2026-09-13 identified no current unresolved customer-data compromise. Hits for Rently (proptech smart-access) are a distinct company.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

Native category is crm: Retently is an NPS/CSAT/CES customer-experience platform. Source Marketing/Data are not in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist.

Official recommended auth is X-Api-Key. Pinned source sends lowercase x-api-key (HTTP header names are case-insensitive). Legacy Authorization api_key= and query api_key are omitted. Writes, attribute-filter query fanout, and the upstream user-agent are omitted.
